intent: Bootstrap the orbit-crm API skeleton
actions: Created Fastify app with a health route
Added Postgres connection pool
TODO: pick a session store
summary: API skeleton with a health endpoint and a Postgres pool; the session store is still an open question.

intent: Contacts table migration and CRUD routes
actions: Wrote SQL migration 0001_contacts
Added /v1/contacts list, create and update handlers
summary: Contacts CRUD is live on top of a plain SQL migration.

intent: Wire Redis as the login session cache
actions: Added redis service to docker compose
Session middleware reads and writes Redis with a 12 hour TTL
NEXT: load test with two replicas
summary: Login sessions now live in Redis with a 12 hour TTL shared by both API replicas.

intent: Review the Redis session middleware
actions: Flagged missing reconnect handling in the Redis client
Suggested a sliding TTL on session touch
summary: Review of the Redis session store: reconnect handling is missing and a sliding TTL was suggested.

intent: Issue JWT access tokens with a 24 hour lifetime
actions: Sign HS256 access tokens on login
Set the access token expiry to 24 hours
No refresh flow yet
summary: Login returns a JWT access token valid for 24 hours; the mobile logout complaints are solved.

intent: Coordinate sprint 2: campaigns and reminders
actions: Assigned the email campaign worker to codex
Assigned the reminder scheduler to claude
pending: decide the job queue technology
summary: Sprint 2 planned around campaign emails and reminders; the queue technology is undecided.

intent: RabbitMQ consumer for campaign emails
actions: Added rabbitmq service to docker compose
Publisher in /v1/campaigns/send
Worker consumes email jobs and calls the mail provider
summary: Campaign emails are published to RabbitMQ and sent by a worker container.

intent: Reminder scheduler with a cron scan
actions: Cron job every minute scans due reminders
TODO: handle user time zones
summary: Reminders fire from a per minute cron scan; time zones are not handled yet.

intent: Contacts list page with table and filters
actions: Built the contacts table with a status filter
Added an empty state illustration
summary: The contacts page renders the list with filters and an empty state.

intent: Freeze /v1 routes and add the version prefix
actions: Moved all public routes under /v1
Unversioned paths now return 404
summary: The public API is served under /v1; unversioned paths return 404.

intent: Structured JSON logging middleware
actions: Added a JSON logger with level and message fields
Request id generated per request and propagated to handlers
summary: Every log line is JSON with level, message, requestId and userId.

intent: Write API docs for /v1 contacts and campaigns
actions: Documented request and response schemas
Added curl examples for every endpoint
summary: API reference for the contacts and campaigns endpoints with curl examples.

intent: Fix the timezone bug in the reminder scheduler
actions: Reminders fired at UTC midnight instead of the user local time
Store the user timezone and convert due dates with Intl.DateTimeFormat
summary: Fixed reminders firing at the wrong hour: due dates are now converted using the user timezone.

intent: Extract translations to ICU message format
actions: Moved reminder and email strings to locales/*.json
Plural rules handled via Intl.PluralRules
summary: Translations use ICU message format; plural bugs in the Portuguese reminder texts are fixed.

intent: CSV import for contacts
actions: Streaming CSV parser with 10k row batches
Import report listing rejected rows
summary: Contacts can be imported from CSV in batches with a rejected rows report.

intent: Sprint 3 kickoff: webhooks, exports and stability
actions: Assigned webhook delivery to claude
Assigned the GDPR export to codex
pending: review the Redis operational cost
summary: Sprint 3 planned around webhooks, GDPR export and infrastructure simplification.

intent: Deduplicate imported contacts by email
actions: Case insensitive unique index on contacts.email
Merge duplicates keeping the newest record
summary: Duplicate contacts merged by email with a unique index preventing new ones.

intent: Migrate the session cache from Redis to embedded SQLite
actions: Sessions table in SQLite with an expires_at index
Removed the redis service from docker compose
Deleted REDIS_URL from the config
summary: Login sessions moved from Redis to an embedded SQLite table; the Redis container is gone.

intent: Webhook delivery with exponential backoff retries
actions: Delivery attempts table
Backoff schedule 1m, 5m, 25m, 2h, 10h
Dead letter table after five failed attempts
summary: Webhooks retry with exponential backoff and are parked in a dead letter table after five attempts.

intent: GDPR data export endpoint
actions: POST /v1/me/export builds a zip with contacts, reminders and invoices
TODO: expire download links after 24 hours
summary: Users can export all of their data as a zip archive.

intent: Dark mode for the dashboard
actions: Theme tokens for light and dark palettes
Respect prefers-color-scheme with a manual toggle
summary: The dashboard supports dark mode through CSS tokens and a toggle.

intent: Shorten access tokens to 15 minutes and add refresh rotation
actions: Access token lifetime reduced to 15 minutes
Refresh tokens stored hashed in a refresh_tokens table and rotated on use
Web and mobile clients perform silent refresh
summary: Access tokens now expire after 15 minutes; rotating refresh tokens keep users logged in.

intent: Review refresh token rotation for replay attacks
actions: Confirmed the old refresh token is revoked after rotation
Suggested family revocation on reuse detection
summary: Refresh rotation reviewed; reuse detection with family revocation suggested.

intent: Token bucket rate limiter per API key
actions: Limiter middleware allows 100 requests per minute per API key
429 responses carry a Retry-After header
summary: All /v1 routes are rate limited per API key with a token bucket.

intent: Document the authentication flow and rate limits
actions: Documented login, refresh and 429 handling
Removed the outdated 24 hour token note
summary: Auth docs cover 15 minute access tokens, refresh rotation and rate limit headers.

intent: Replace RabbitMQ with a Postgres job queue
actions: jobs table polled with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
Removed the rabbitmq service and the consumer container
Email sending now runs inside the API process
summary: Email jobs moved from RabbitMQ to a Postgres table polled with SKIP LOCKED; the broker is removed.

intent: Verify the queue migration and close sprint 3
actions: Confirmed no rabbitmq references remain in the repo
pending: monitor job latency for a week
summary: Sprint 3 closed; RabbitMQ fully removed; job latency to be monitored.

intent: Server side invoice PDF rendering with headless Chromium
actions: Worker renders the invoice HTML with headless Chromium
PDF stored in object storage behind a signed URL
summary: Invoice PDFs render server side with Chromium and are stored in object storage.

intent: Fix the flaky contacts import integration test
actions: The test depended on directory listing order
Sorted fixture rows before asserting
summary: Flaky CSV import test fixed by sorting rows before comparison.

intent: Cursor pagination for the contacts list
actions: Replaced offset pagination with a keyset cursor on (created_at, id)
Infinite scroll in the contacts page
summary: The contacts list uses cursor pagination and infinite scroll.

intent: Handoff: prepare the v1.0 release checklist
actions: Collected pending items from every agent handoff
NEXT: run the release checklist with codex
summary: Release checklist drafted from all agent handoffs; codex takes the release run.
